observations: Photo 0: one used car tyre, not on a rim, shown tread face up on a concrete floor; part of another tyre is at the left edge.
Photo 0: wide summer-type tread with four straight grooves and angled sipes; tread is visibly worn and dirty, grooves still present but shallow-looking toward the shoulders.
Photo 0: no sidewall is shown, so the brand, size, load and speed rating and DOT date code cannot be read.
Photo 0: a shop watermark 'N.J. VENTURE' and 'POSTED ON' text sits across the tread.
The seller's lines about never repaired or opened, works perfectly, receipt and warranty are boilerplate that does not fit a foreign-used tyre.

read_from: photo 0 tread only, no sidewall marking visible

claims.evidence: The size is printed on the sidewall, which photo 0 does not show. The tread looks wide but that does not fix the size.
Photo 0 shows a used tyre but its origin cannot be shown by a photo.
Photo 0 shows clear tread wear and a used, dirty tyre.
The inner liner and sidewalls are not shown, so patches or plugs cannot be ruled out.
No sign of leaks, bulges or cracks can be checked without sidewall and inner liner photos.
No receipt shown; a used imported tyre normally carries no warranty.

risks.risk: Actual size, brand and load or speed rating differ from what the seller says, and size sets the price.
risks.proof: Sharp photo of the sidewall showing the brand and the full size marking.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; size and brand unknown

risks.risk: Tyre is old; rubber hardened or cracked even with tread left.
risks.proof: Close photo of the four-digit DOT date code on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: as aged tyre near end of life

risks.risk: Tread depth too low for safe use.
risks.proof: Photo of a tread depth gauge or a coin set in the main groove.

risks.risk: Plugs, patches, sidewall bulges or cuts hidden on the parts not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of both sidewalls and the inner liner.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the sidewall showing brand and the full size marking.
Close photo of the DOT date code.
Tread depth gauge or coin in the groove.
Photos of both sidewalls and the inside of the tyre.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows only the tread of a used tyre, so the size and brand that set its price cannot be read and the seller's size claim is unproven; a sidewall photo with the size marking is needed before even a worst-case price.
